get.summary:
Auctions provides unified auction listing with optional denom filters and
pagination.
get.description:
Supports multiple query patterns based on provided filters for optimal
performance: both denoms (pair index), single sell_denom, single bid_denom,
or no filters. Applies appropriate prefix filtering to optimize index
usage. Supports pagination with consistent ordering by auction ID.

parameters.name: sell_denom
parameters.description: Optional sell denom filter; restricts to auctions selling this denomination.

parameters.name: bid_denom
parameters.description: Optional bid denom filter; restricts to auctions bidding this denomination.

get.summary:
AuctionByNFT queries the auction associated with specific NFT escrow
markers.
get.description:
Returns the auction where the specified class_id and nft_id appear as
escrow markers. Scans auctions to find matching NFT identifiers (expected
to be unique). Uses unpaginated scan since NFT markers should be unique per
auction.

parameters.name: class_id
parameters.description: NFT class ID of the escrow marker.

parameters.name: nft_id
parameters.description: NFT ID of the escrow marker.

get.summary:
AuctionsByPairPriceRange queries auctions for a pair whose effective price
falls within bounds.
get.description:
Filters auctions by sell/bid denom pair using AuctionsBySellBid index.
Applies prefix filtering to iterate only auctions for the specified pair.
Price filtering is placeholder (marked as TODO in implementation).
Supports pagination with consistent ordering by auction ID.

parameters.name: sell_denom
parameters.description: Sell denom of the pair (denomination being auctioned).

parameters.name: bid_denom
parameters.description: Bid denom of the pair (denomination used for bidding).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description:
Minimum price threshold as bid-per-sell cosmos.Dec string (optional,
inclusive).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description:
Maximum price threshold as bid-per-sell cosmos.Dec string (optional,
inclusive).

get.summary: AuctionsBySeller queries auctions created by a specific seller address.
get.description:
Returns auctions where the specified address appears as the seller.
Uses filtered pagination over primary AuctionsMap (no dedicated index
assumed). Results ordered by auction ID ascending.

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description:
Seller address to filter auctions by; returns auctions created by this
address

get.summary: Auction queries a single auction by ID.
get.description:
Returns complete auction data including escrow details, bids, and NFT
markers. Direct lookup by auction_id for fast retrieval.

parameters.name: auction_id
parameters.description: ID of the auction to retrieve

get.summary:
Metrics computes comprehensive module metrics including escrow balances and
trade statistics.
get.description:
Aggregates escrow balances: AMM pool reserves, offer-locked coins, PFAND
requirements. Counts auctions across all records by summing sell amounts.
Calculates total fees earned across all pools. Counts total trades by
iterating the trades map. Returns consolidated TradeMetrics for monitoring
and invariants checking.

get.summary: AddressMetrics computes lifetime activity metrics for a specific address.
get.description:
Aggregates all whaleswap activity for the address across trading, LP
operations, leverage positions, orderbook offers, and auctions. Only tracks
coins with registered denom metadata to prevent spam. All metrics are
cumulative lifetime totals computed at query time. Returns zero values for
addresses with no activity.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Address to compute metrics for; must be a valid bech32 address

get.summary: AddressMetricsAll lists all stored address metrics with pagination.
get.description:
Iterates the AddressMetrics map in key order and returns the aggregated
metrics for every known address. Supports standard pagination to avoid
exhausting gRPC limits. Only use this endpoint for analytics dashboards or
invariants; it can be expensive on large datasets.

get.summary: Offer queries a single offer by ID.
get.description:
Returns offer data including maker, amounts, status, and timestamps.
Direct lookup by offer_id for fast retrieval.

parameters.name: offer_id
parameters.description: ID of the offer to retrieve

get.summary:
Offers provides unified offer listing with optional denom filters and
pagination.
get.description:
Supports multiple query patterns based on provided filters for optimal
performance: both denoms (pair+price index), single have_denom, single
want_denom, or no filters. Canonicalizes pairs for consistent indexing and
ordering. Supports pagination with consistent ordering by offer ID.

parameters.name: have_denom
parameters.description: Optional have denom filter; restricts to offers selling this denomination.

parameters.name: want_denom
parameters.description: Optional want denom filter; restricts to offers buying this denomination.

get.summary:
OffersBest returns up to limit best-priced offers for a pair (convenience
endpoint).
get.description:
Returns top offers for a pair sorted by price (want-per-have, ascending =
best for takers). Canonicalizes pair for indexing; applies limit
(defaulting to 10) via pagination. Uses OffersByPairPrice index for
efficient ordered retrieval.

parameters.name: have_denom
parameters.description: Have denom of the pair (denomination being sold).

parameters.name: want_denom
parameters.description: Want denom of the pair (denomination being bought).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of best-priced offers to return (default: 10).

get.summary:
OffersByDenom queries offers that reference a specific denom either as have
or want side.
get.description:
Returns offers where the specified denom appears in either have_denom or
want_denom. Uses role filter to restrict to "have" side, "want" side, or
both (when empty). Leverages OffersByHave and OffersByWant indices when
role specified for efficiency. Falls back to filtered scan over primary
OffersMap when role unspecified. Supports pagination with consistent
ordering by offer ID.

parameters.name: denom
parameters.description: Denomination to search for in offers.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description:
Role filter: "have" restricts to have-denom, "want" restricts to
want-denom, empty string includes both sides.

get.summary: OffersByOwner queries offers by owner address with optional status filter.
get.description:
Returns offers owned by the specified address, optionally filtered by
status. Uses indexed queries when both owner and status provided for
optimal performance. Falls back to filtered scans for partial filters to
avoid nil entries. Supports pagination with consistent ordering by offer
ID.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Owner address to filter offers by; must be a valid bech32 address

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Optional status filter; valid values are "open", "closed", "cancelled"
If empty, returns offers with any status. Enables indexed queries when
combined with owner.

get.summary:
OffersByPairPriceRange queries offers for a pair whose price lies within
optional bounds.
get.description:
Filters offers by denom pair and price range (want-per-have ratio).
Canonicalizes pair for consistent indexing; bounds are inclusive and
optional. Uses OffersByPairPrice index for efficient ordered scanning.
Supports pagination with ordering by price ascending.

parameters.name: have_denom
parameters.description: Have denom of the pair (denomination being sold).

parameters.name: want_denom
parameters.description: Want denom of the pair (denomination being bought).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description:
Minimum price threshold as want-per-have cosmos.Dec string (optional,
inclusive).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description:
Maximum price threshold as want-per-have cosmos.Dec string (optional,
inclusive).

get.summary: Params queries the current whaleswap module parameters.
get.description:
Returns all module configuration values including fees, limits, and module
settings. No filtering or pagination supported (empty request accepted).

get.summary: Pool queries a single AMM pool by ID.
get.description:
Returns complete pool data including reserves, shares denom, and
configuration. Direct lookup by pool_id for fast retrieval.

parameters.name: pool_id
parameters.description: ID of the pool to retrieve

get.summary: Pools lists all AMM pools with pagination.
get.description:
Returns all pools in the system with no filtering. Uses direct pagination
over the primary PoolsMap. Results ordered by pool ID ascending.

get.summary:
PoolsByDenom queries all pools that include a specific denom on either
side.
get.description:
Returns pools where the specified denom appears in either coin position.
Uses filtered pagination over the primary PoolsMap. Results ordered by pool
ID ascending.

parameters.name: denom
parameters.description:
Denomination to search for; returns pools where this denom appears on
either side.

get.summary: PoolsByOwner queries pools where the owner holds non-zero shares balance.
get.description:
Returns pools where the specified owner has a positive balance of pool
shares. Uses bank module balance checks for each pool's shares denom. Falls
back to filtered scan when no dedicated index exists. Results ordered by
pool ID ascending.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Owner address to filter pools by; must be a valid bech32 address

get.summary: PoolsByPair queries all pools matching a denom pair with pagination.
get.description:
Returns pools containing exactly the specified denom pair, regardless of
order. Canonicalizes the pair internally for consistent lookup. Uses
filtered pagination over the primary PoolsMap. Results ordered by pool ID
ascending.

parameters.name: base_denom
parameters.description:
Base denom of the pair (price is quote/base); order with quote_denom is
irrelevant.

parameters.name: quote_denom
parameters.description: Quote denom of the pair; combined with base_denom forms the trading pair.

get.summary:
PoolsByPairPriceRange queries pools for a pair whose instantaneous price
falls within optional bounds.
get.description:
Filters pools by denom pair and price range (quote/base ratio from
reserves). Bounds are inclusive and optional; omitting both returns all
matching pairs. Uses filtered pagination over the primary PoolsMap. Results
ordered by pool ID ascending.

parameters.name: base_denom
parameters.description:
Base denom of the pair (price is quote/base); order with quote_denom is
irrelevant.

parameters.name: quote_denom
parameters.description: Quote denom of the pair; combined with base_denom forms the trading pair.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price threshold as cosmos.Dec string (optional, inclusive).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum price threshold as cosmos.Dec string (optional, inclusive).

get.summary: PoolBySharesDenom queries the pool that mints a specific shares denom.
get.description:
Returns the pool with matching shares_denom (expected to be unique).
Scans pools to find the matching one; uses unpaginated scan since shares
denoms are expected to be unique.

parameters.name: shares_denom
parameters.description: Shares denomination to find the corresponding pool for.

get.summary:
PositionsByAddress lists all leverage positions for an address with
optional filters.
get.description:
Uses indexed queries on PositionsByAddressIndex with
(address,status,position_id) keys. Defaults to OPEN positions when status
unspecified. Applies additional filters for pool_id, borrowed_denom,
collateral_denom as specified. Supports pagination with consistent ordering
by position ID.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description:
Account address to filter positions by; returns all positions owned by this
address.

parameters.name: borrowed_denom
parameters.description: Optional filter by borrowed denomination.

parameters.name: collateral_denom
parameters.description: Optional filter by collateral denomination.

parameters.name: pool_id
parameters.description: Optional filter by pool ID (cannot combine with borrowed/collateral denoms).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional filter by lifecycle status; defaults to OPEN positions.

get.summary:
PositionsByPool lists all leverage positions in a specific pool with
optional status filter.
get.description:
Uses indexed queries on PositionsByPoolIndex with
(pool_id,status,position_id) keys. Defaults to OPEN positions when status
unspecified. Filters positions by the specified pool_id. Supports
pagination with consistent ordering by position ID.

parameters.name: pool_id
parameters.description: Pool ID to filter positions by; returns all positions in this pool

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional filter by lifecycle status; defaults to OPEN positions.

get.summary:
Position queries a leverage position by ID and includes comprehensive
health and interest information.
get.description:
Retrieves complete position data including collateral, debt, and status.
Computes real-time interest accrual based on elapsed time and rates.
Calculates current collateral ratio and liquidation health status.
Determines action permissions: close by owner, initialize/finalize
liquidation. Returns enriched position data with computed fields for UI
consumption.

parameters.name: position_id
parameters.description: ID of the leverage position to retrieve

get.summary: Trades lists trades with optional denom filters and pagination.
get.description:
Returns trades filtered by sent_denom and/or received_denom if specified.
Uses filtered pagination over primary TradesMap for flexibility. Checks
TotalSent and TotalReceived coin arrays for denom presence.
Supports pagination with consistent ordering by trade ID.

parameters.name: sent_denom
parameters.description: Optional sent denom filter; restricts to trades where this denom was sent.

parameters.name: received_denom
parameters.description:
Optional received denom filter; restricts to trades where this denom was
received.

get.summary:
TradesByAuction queries all trades involving auction redemptions for a
specific auction.
get.description:
Returns all trades where the specified auction_id appears as a participant.
Uses TradesByAuctionIndex with (auction_id, trade_id) keys for efficient
lookup. Applies prefix filtering to iterate only trades for the specified
auction. Supports pagination with consistent ordering by trade ID.

parameters.name: auction_id
parameters.description: Auction ID to filter trades by; returns all trades involving this auction

get.summary: TradesByOffer queries all trades involving a specific offer.
get.description:
Returns all trades where the specified offer_id appears as a participant.
Uses TradesByOfferIndex with (offer_id, trade_id) keys for efficient
lookup. Applies prefix filtering to iterate only trades for the specified
offer. Supports pagination with consistent ordering by trade ID.

parameters.name: offer_id
parameters.description: Offer ID to filter trades by; returns all trades involving this offer

get.summary: TradesByPool queries all trades involving a specific AMM pool.
get.description:
Returns all trades where the specified pool_id appears as a participant.
Uses TradesByPoolIndex with (pool_id, trade_id) keys for efficient lookup.
Applies prefix filtering to iterate only trades for the specified pool.
Supports pagination with consistent ordering by trade ID.

parameters.name: pool_id
parameters.description: Pool ID to filter trades by; returns all trades involving this AMM pool

get.summary: TradesByTaker queries all trades executed by a specific taker address.
get.description:
Returns all trades where the specified address appears as the taker
(trader). Uses TradesByTraderIndex with (trader_address, trade_id) keys for
efficient lookup. Applies prefix filtering to iterate only trades for the
specified trader. Supports pagination with consistent ordering by trade ID.

parameters.name: taker
parameters.description:
Taker address to filter trades by; returns all trades executed by this
address

get.summary: Trade queries a single trade by ID.
get.description:
Returns complete trade data including participants, amounts, and
operations. Direct lookup by trade_id for fast retrieval.

parameters.name: trade_id
parameters.description: ID of the trade to retrieve

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

reverse.description:
reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending
order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

cosmos.base.v1beta1.DecCoin.description:

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.AddressMetric.description:
AddressMetrics aggregates lifetime whaleswap activity for a specific address.
All metrics are cumulative totals, not current state snapshots.

NOTE: Only coins with existing denom metadata are tracked to prevent spam
and focus on relevant assets. Coins without metadata are excluded from all
volume and balance aggregations.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.AuctionRecord.description: AuctionRecord stores metadata for a whaleswap-created auction escrow.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.AuctionRedeem.title: AuctionRedeem operation for recording auction redemption in Trade history

interest_due.description: Decimal amount of interest owed right now (borrowed denom).

time_elapsed.description: Seconds since the last settlement reference.

annual_rate.description: Annual rate applied for this position (borrowed denom entry).

accrued_interest.description: Unpaid interest carried forward from prior settlements (borrowed denom).

interest_rate.description:
═════ PER-POSITION SNAPSHOTS (sticky to this position) ═════
Annual interest rates per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order).
Each amount is a LegacyDec string representing APR (per-year accrual).

min_collateral_ratio.description:
Minimum collateral ratio used for health/liquidation checks (cosmos.Dec
string).

liquidation_threshold.description: Liquidation threshold used for liquidation checks (cosmos.Dec string).

initial_borrowed.description: Opening principal snapshot for analytics/limits (borrowed denom).

total_interest_paid.description: Lifetime interest paid by the user (borrowed denom).

last_interest_settlement_time.description: Timestamp of the last time interest was settled into accrued_interest.

accrued_interest_remainder.description:
Fractional interest remainder (<1 borrowed coin) preserved between
settlements.

trade_ids.description:
Trade IDs associated with this position over its lifetime.

Semantics:
- Includes the opening trade that created the position.
- Includes all trades from partial and full closes.
- Includes trades from liquidation paths.
- Includes trades from MsgCoverPosition (covers) auto-close path.

Values are whaleswap Trade.trade_id (uint64).

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.LeveragePosit.description: LeveragePosition represents an active leverage position for a trader.

updated_timestamp.title: Deprecated for backward-compatible JSON decoding of old genesis

pfand_locked.description: pfand_locked is the PFAND coin locked for liquid-mode offers.

settlement_mode.description: settlement_mode mirrors MsgMakeOffer.settlement_mode for this offer.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.OfferData.description:
OfferData mirrors orderbook offer state.

Status values: "open" | "closed" | "cancelled".

pfand_per_offer.description: pfand_per_offer is the PFAND coin required for liquid-mode offers.

valuation_fee_pct.description: valuation_fee_pct is the percentage applied per valuation_period.

valuation_period.description:
valuation_period defines the time duration to which valuation_fee_pct
applies.

bid_timeout.description:
bid_timeout defines the minimum duration a placed bid must remain pending
before it can be claimed by the bidder.

minimum_bid_percent_increase.description:
minimum_bid_percent_increase specifies the minimum percent increase
required over the current valuation for a new bid to be accepted.

block_delay_before_close.title:
═════ LEVERAGE PARAMETERS ═════
Block delay before position owner can close position

block_delay_before_liquidation.title: Block delay before liquidation can be finalized after initialization

coins.description:
coins holds exactly two coins in canonical denom order (denom[0] <
denom[1]). All math derives price as P = coins[1].amount / coins[0].amount.

min_price.description:
Deprecated legacy price band fields retained for decoding old genesis
exports. Migration logic ignores their values and clears them.

block_height.title:
Deprecated legacy fields for backward-compatible JSON decoding of old
genesis

fees_earned.title: cumulative swap fees retained by the pool (accrue to LPs)

interest_rate.description:
═════ LEVERAGE FIELDS ═════
Annual interest rates per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order).
Each amount is a decimal string representing APR (per-year accrual).

min_initial_collateral_ratio.description:
═════ PER-POOL LEVERAGE RISK PARAMETERS (per-denom) ═════
Minimum collateral ratio required at position open per reserve denom
(exactly two, canonical order). Each amount is a decimal string (> 1).

max_leverage_ratio.description:
Deprecated: maximum leverage ratio per reserve denom.
This field is ignored by the keeper; risk is enforced via
min_collateral_ratio, liquidation_threshold, and max_borrow_percent.
Kept for backward-compatible JSON/proto decoding of older clients.

liquidation_threshold.description:
Collateral ratio threshold below which position is liquidatable per reserve
denom (exactly two, canonical order). Each amount is a decimal string
(> 1).

max_borrow_percent.description:
Maximum borrow capacity per reserve denom as DecCoins (exactly two,
canonical order). Each amount is a decimal in [0,1).

bound_percent.description:
Directional price-impact bounds keyed by the sold denom.
Each amount must satisfy 0 < x <= 1; x == 1 disables the bound (unbounded).
Missing entries default to 1 for both pool denoms. Stored in canonical pool
order (coins[0], coins[1]). During swaps, selling denom D enforces that the
post-trade price of D quoted in the opposite denom may drop by at most
x fraction (B = 1/(1-x) multiplier). Values outside (0,1] are rejected at
validation time.

fee_rate.description:
fee_rate is the per-denom pool swap fee rate (amount in [0,1)), exactly two
entries in canonical pool order matching coins[0].denom and coins[1].denom.
Fee is applied to the OUTPUT denom of each swap leg: for exact-in, the
computed gross output is reduced by fee; for exact-out, the required gross
output is inflated so net (after fee) meets the target. Fees accrue to
fees_earned in the output denom.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.Pool.description:
Pool describes AMM pool state.

Notes:
- coin_a.denom < coin_b.denom lexicographically (canonical order)
- fee_rate is a per-denom decimal rate in [0,1) as DecCoins
- coin_a.amount/coin_b.amount are sdk.Int strings.
- The instantaneous price used by price-based queries is derived from
  reserves as P = coin_b / coin_a, consistent with the notes above.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.SettlementMod.description:
SettlementMode selects how offers fund the "have" side:
- ESCROW: Escrow base have in the module at offer creation.
- LIQUID: Do not escrow base; lock PFAND and settle from maker balance at
take.

swap_in.description:
Exactly one of swap_in (exact-in) or swap_out (exact-out) must be set.
Use message-level min_output for rate constraints across legs.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer to take from; offer must exist and be in open status.

take_units.description:
Units to take (sdk.Int string). If empty, take full remaining. Must be
positive and ≤ remaining.

offer_id.title:
═════ DEPRECATED FIELDS (fields 2-10) - for migration compatibility ═════
These fields are kept for backwards compatibility. Migration logic should
read these and populate the new fields (20+) below.
Deprecated: use operations field 23 and trader field 20 instead

pool_id.title: Deprecated: use operations field 23 to infer pool swaps

auction_id.title: Deprecated: use operations field 23 to infer auction redemptions

Trader address (was taker in old schema, field 3)

height.title: Block height when trade was executed (was field 4 in old schema)

timestamp.title: Timestamp when trade was executed (was field 5 in old schema)

operations.description:
Operations executed in this trade (from tx.proto TradeOperation).
Each operation records what was sent/received for that specific step.
Replaces offer_id/pool_id/auction_id fields (2, 8, 9) from old schema.

total_sent.title: Aggregated totals across all operations (was single sent field 6)

total_received.title: Aggregated totals across all operations (was single received field 7)

note.title: Optional note (was field 10 in old schema)

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.Trade.description:
Trade captures a batch of operations executed atomically in a single message.
Operations are stored in execution order, preserving the exact sequence from
the original message (MsgMakeTrade, MsgPoolSwap, MsgTakeOffer,
MsgRedeemAuction).

escrowed_pool_coins.title: Sum of reserves across all AMM pools

escrowed_offer_coins.title: Sum of remaining_have over all open escrow-mode offers

escrowed_pfand.title: Sum of pfand_locked over all open liquid-mode offers

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.TradeMetrics.description:
TradeMetrics reports the expected whaleswap module balances broken down by
subsystem, and summary counters useful for monitoring and invariants.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.TradeOperatio.description:
TradeOperation allows mixing pool swap legs, orderbook takes, and auction
redemptions. When stored in Trade.operations, sent/received fields are
populated with execution results. When used in MsgMakeTrade.operations,
sent/received are empty (populated during execution).
